title: REST API and Webhooks
meta: Custom REST endpoints and webhooks that connect your WooCommerce plugin with other systems, secured and documented. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: WooCommerce REST API endpoints and webhooks
overview: When your plugin has to talk to a CRM, an ERP, a shipping tool or your own app, we build the connection. That means custom REST API endpoints with authentication and permission checks, and outgoing webhooks that fire on orders, customers or your own events. Every endpoint validates input, returns clear errors and is documented with example requests, so other developers can use it right away.

pkgs.blurb: Two secured endpoints with example requests.
More endpoints, an outgoing webhook and delivery logs.
A full API layer with signed webhooks, paging and a test suite.

faq: Can you extend the core WooCommerce REST API?
Yes. We can add fields to existing orders and products, or add new routes in your own namespace. We choose the approach that keeps your changes safe through WooCommerce updates.
How do you secure the endpoints?
Every route has authentication, a permission check and strict input validation. We support WooCommerce API keys or application passwords, and never expose customer data without a capability check.
Do you build the system on the other end too?
We connect to it. If the other system has an API, send its documentation and we confirm the fit. Building the other system itself is a separate piece of work.
No. We queue deliveries with Action Scheduler, so the customer's checkout finishes first and the call goes out in the background. Failed deliveries are retried and logged.
